items.raw_excerpt: El joven valenciano se trasladó a Valdemoro-Sierra en busca de trabajo y una vida más asequible y acabó abriendo su propio negocio
items.summary_en: Mario, 23, moved from Valencia to Valdemoro-Sierra looking for work and a cheaper life. He ended up opening his own bar in a village of only 96 people. He says the town needs more young people who are willing to work.
items.summary_ko: 스물세 살 마리오는 일자리와 더 저렴한 삶을 찾아 발렌시아를 떠나 발데모로시에라로 이사했습니다. 그는 인구 96명뿐인 마을에서 자신의 바를 열게 되었습니다. 그는 이 마을에 일할 젊은 사람이 더 필요하다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: A 23-year-old left Valencia to open a bar in a village of 96 people
items.title_ko: 스물세 살 청년, 인구 96명 마을에 바를 열다
items.title_original: Mario (23 años), el joven que dejó Valencia para abrir un bar en un pueblo de 96 habitantes: "Lo que falta aquí es gente joven que trabaje" - Levante-EMV

items.raw_excerpt: A rare lamb worth up to $25,000 has gone missing from an Adelaide Hills property, with its heartbroken owners urging the community to keep an eye out for the distinctive breed.
items.summary_en: A rare days-old lamb went missing from a property in the Adelaide Hills. The lamb may be worth up to $25,000. Its owners ask the community to watch for the unusual breed.
items.summary_ko: 애들레이드 힐스의 한 농장에서 태어난 지 며칠 된 희귀 품종 양 한 마리가 사라졌다. 이 양은 최대 2만 5천 달러의 가치가 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 주인은 지역 주민들에게 이 특이한 품종을 눈여겨봐 달라고 부탁했다.
items.title_en: Rare lamb worth up to $25,000 missing from Adelaide Hills farm
items.title_ko: 2만 5천 달러짜리 희귀 양, 애들레이드 힐스 농장에서 실종
items.title_original: Owners fear rare days-old lamb worth up to $25K stolen

items.raw_excerpt: Mann condemns Delhi Police’s “Taliban-like” attitude after video shows cops with boots inside Delhi’s Gurdwara Bangla Sahib.
items.summary_en: A video shows police officers wearing shoes inside Gurdwara Bangla Sahib in Delhi. Punjab leader Bhagwant Mann criticized the police for this behavior. The temple is a holy place for Sikhs, who remove their shoes before entering.
items.summary_ko: 델리의 구르드와라 방글라 사히브 안에서 경찰들이 신발을 신고 있는 영상이 공개됐다. 펀자브 주의 바그완트 만은 경찰의 이런 행동을 비판했다. 이 사원은 시크교의 성지로, 들어갈 때 신발을 벗는다.
items.title_en: Shoes inside a Delhi temple upset a state leader
items.title_ko: 델리 사원 안에서 신발 신은 경찰, 논란
items.title_original: Mann slams Delhi Police’s ‘Taliban-like’ attitude over video of cops with shoes inside Bangla Sahib

items.raw_excerpt: Riders must be at least 16 years old and anyone using the devices, including passengers, are required to wear properly fitting helmets, the province says. Personal electric vehicles can't go faster than 25 km/h under the incoming speed limit.
items.summary_en: Manitoba will let personal electric vehicles on its roads next year. Riders must be at least 16 years old. Everyone on the device, including passengers, must wear a helmet. The vehicles cannot go faster than 25 km/h.
items.summary_ko: 매니토바주가 내년부터 개인용 전동 이동수단을 도로에서 허용합니다. 이용자는 만 16세 이상이어야 하고, 탑승자 모두 헬멧을 써야 합니다. 속도는 시속 25킬로미터를 넘을 수 없습니다.
items.title_en: Manitoba sets age and speed rules for e-scooters next year

items.title_original: Age, speed limits for e-scooters and other personal electric vehicles hitting Manitoba roads next year

items.raw_excerpt: Luke Tarrant says he is "disgusted" that fraudsters are pretending to be him on social media.
items.summary_en: Luke Tarrant lost his leg during an adventure. He says fraudsters now pretend to be him on social media. He is telling people not to send any money to fake accounts.

items.raw_excerpt: The controversial movement that asks you to do as much good for the world as you can.
items.summary_en: An Australian man gave one of his kidneys to a stranger through an altruistic donation program. His decision to also give 10% of his income for life has drawn a lot of public interest.

items.raw_excerpt: A wedding album found dumped in Wakefield sparks an extraordinary family reunion.
items.summary_en: A wedding album from 1957 was found dumped in Wakefield, England. People worked to trace the family in the photos. Their search led to a joyful family reunion.

items.summary_en: On February 22, the traditional wrestling festival of Thủ Lễ village in Quảng Điền, Huế began. It drew many local people and visitors. The event fell on the sixth day of the Lunar New Year holiday.

items.raw_excerpt: North Melbourne recovers from an early scare to beat Fremantle, while Carlton and Hawthorn triumph over Sydney and Brisbane respectively.
items.summary_en: North Melbourne recovered from an early scare to beat Fremantle. Carlton beat Sydney, and Hawthorn beat Brisbane in the same round.

items.raw_excerpt: When we look at a map of Europe, the Azores seem far away. When we look at a map of the Atlantic, the opposite happens.
items.summary_en: The Azores often look far away on a map of Europe. But on a map of the Atlantic, the islands sit right in the middle. This new position puts them at the heart of a growing digital Atlantic.

items.raw_excerpt: La jornada acercó al pueblo Huave/Ikoots información sobre la propuesta de reforma y el derecho a la Consulta Previa, Libre, Informada, de Buena Fe y Culturalmente Adecuada San Dionisio del Mar, Oa…
items.summary_en: Tania Caballero met the Huave/Ikoots people in San Dionisio del Mar. The meeting explained the plan to change the Oaxaca Constitution. It also covered the right to free and informed consultation.

items.raw_excerpt: This French expression contains a timeless warning.
items.summary_en: The French phrase 'L'habit ne fait pas le moine' means you shouldn't judge someone by their clothes. It's a small piece of everyday wisdom that has stood the test of time.

items.summary_en: South Africa is chasing Australia's first-innings total of 390 at Kingsmead. Steve Smith took a sharp catch in the field to remove Temba Bavuma. The home batters started well before Australia broke through.

items.raw_excerpt: One Taiwanese pair each in men's and women's doubles advanced to the finals of the 2026 Clash of Clans Arctic Open, a Badminton World Federation (BWF) Super 500 tournament, in Vantaa, Finland, on Saturday (local time).
items.summary_en: Two Taiwanese teams reached the finals at a badminton tournament in Finland. One men's doubles pair and one women's doubles pair each advanced. The event is the Clash of Clans Arctic Open in Vantaa.

items.summary_en: Protesters are camping outside the Home Affairs office in Durban. They say they will block the office from reopening. The protest began after foreign nationals were allowed to apply for asylum there.

items.raw_excerpt: The men reported their rare find to a local museum where it was confirmed that the fossilised remains dated to the Cretaceous Period
items.summary_en: Four college students found rare dinosaur egg fossils during a walk in southern China. They saw strange stones covered in red mud in Pingxiang City. Experts later confirmed the eggs date back to the late Cretaceous Period.

items.summary_en: A house in Ucassaim village in North Goa is famous for a movie role. It appears in the Drishyam films with Ajay Devgn. Fans still come to see it in person.
